measures.title: Mobile County senior property tax exemption and homestead exemption income limit (Act 2026-258)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Mobile County. It would let a qualified taxpayer age 65 or older claim a senior property tax exemption on real property under certain conditions, and would raise the income limit for certain homestead exemptions to $50,000.
measures.yesMeans: Qualified Mobile County taxpayers 65 or older could claim a senior property tax exemption, and the income limit for certain homestead exemptions rises to $50,000.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and these exemption changes do not take effect.

measures.title: Mobile County Pay-As-You-Go Road, Bridge and Drainage Facilities Bonds
measures.summary: Asks whether Mobile County may issue up to $82,000,000 in Pay-As-You-Go Road, Bridge and Drainage Facilities Bonds for building and improving hard-surfaced roads, bridges and surface water drainage facilities, at interest not exceeding 8% per year, maturing $8,200,000 each year from 2030 through 2039. It also asks whether the county may continue levying a special property tax of up to six and one-half mills to pay these and other bonds payable from that tax.
measures.yesMeans: Mobile County may issue up to $82 million in road, bridge and drainage bonds and continue the special tax of up to 6.5 mills to repay them.
measures.noMeans: The county is not authorized to issue these bonds or continue the special tax for them.
